verdict.rationale: Render documents Workflows SDKs for TypeScript and Python that define workflow tasks in code and trigger runs of them. Its marketing claims reliable background processes 'without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic.' The evidence never explicitly documents durability guarantees, long-running execution limits, or the retry semantics themselves, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of durable state/checkpointing, long-running duration support, detailed retry configuration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries

citations.quote: Deploy reliable agents and background processes at scale, without wiring up queues, workers, and retry logic.
The Render SDK for TypeScript provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other TypeScript code
The Render SDK for Python provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other Python code
